claimed_root_cause: FastAPI() is created without docs_url, redoc_url, or openapi_url disabled, and no production overlay or ingress manifest in repo strips those paths before the public bind.
title: FastAPI docs and OpenAPI remain enabled on the 0.0.0.0 API bind
description: The API app is constructed with FastAPI defaults, so /docs, /redoc, and /openapi.json are registered in development and production. Docker and Procfile bind uvicorn on 0.0.0.0, and DEPLOY.md publishes an API domain for /health. Those routes disclose the full management surface (auth, R2 migrate, admin delete, CT Seller, Facebook). Whether a Railway edge or other proxy currently blocks them is not in source and was not probed.

trace.description: app = FastAPI(title=settings.app_name) keeps default documentation and OpenAPI URLs for every environment.
Production startup checks SECRET_KEY, SQLite, and CORS_ORIGINS but does not disable docs or require TRUSTED_HOSTS.
Container starts uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0, so any attached public domain forwards to the default docs routes unless a proxy blocks them.

validation_plan.local: In an isolated loopback sandbox, start app.main:app and confirm unauthenticated GET /docs, /redoc, and /openapi.json return 200 with the operation list. That only proves the application route, not live exposure.
validation_plan.deployment: Owner, from the Railway dashboard or an already-authorized admin path, notes whether the API service has a public domain and whether an edge rule denies /docs, /redoc, and /openapi.json. Do not probe the hostname from this agent.

blockers: Live Railway ingress, private-networking flags, and any path filter in front of the API are not in this repo.
This run must not fetch the public API /docs or /openapi.json.
No sandbox was available to boot uvicorn locally and observe the default routes.

evidence.description: No docs_url=None, redoc_url=None, or openapi_url=None on the FastAPI constructor.
Nixpacks/Procfile path also runs uvicorn on 0.0.0.0 bound to $PORT.
Operators are told to generate a public API domain and to hit /health on that hostname.
TrustedHostMiddleware is added only when TRUSTED_HOSTS is non-empty; empty is the documented default.
